title: Ratio-free positive-unpaired cleanup by progress,observable failure and delayed repayment
statement: For fixed H and positive raw rates,there exist eps,n0 so every0<=A,D<=H,n=min(B-C,E-F)>=n0,C+F<=eps*n has an actual stop with E[sigma+Jnc+Zout^2]<=Zin^2,without an upper ratio bound on the two positive unpaired inventories. Z=15+M-m(A)-m(D),m=(0,2,4,7,7,...).

requires: Exact C3/core list,positive rates,0<=A,D<=H,n=min(B-C,E-F) sufficiently large,C+F<=eps*n. Nonexplosion supplied;no P3 source transfer.
Use source parity-corrected integer progress,raw hazard comparisons and lower physical clock,then the actual guarded drain.
provides: Physical time,all noncore events and every actual Zout^2 are paid by Zin^2 on the stated ratio-free cone.
assumptions: Continue neutral low growth/low-donor core;source0,ready-growth and high-donor core stop at actual landings.
costs: Uniform success p^(6H+8)/2 can be extremely poor. Delayed drain pays every bounded failure cost;g=p^F uses0 only for failure probability bookkeeping.
contract.obstruction: Negative/mixed signs,other minority regimes,unbounded anchors,global receiving and recurrence open. Old total-growth/service clock fails at separated hot scales. No practical solver.
